text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
And with that, today's main race, the 『Oaks』,
comes to a close as the girls wrap up their
splendid Winning Live!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
The contenders in the Triple Tiara chase
now set their sights on autumn.
We eagerly await their fierce evolution at
the 『Shuka Sho』!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
O～su.
……Ah～ man～～～ Did you see that? Kawakami-senpai!
No matter where she went,
everyone was screaming "She's amazing!
Amazing!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Geez～,
that was supposed to be ME!
Being suuuper amazing, praised to high heaven,
becoming the queen!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: All of that……was supposed to be mine——…………

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: …………The waiting room. ……I'm heading back.

(Pandora seemed deeply lost in thought……
After that, she barely spoke a word.)

(And it wasn't just that day.
Even during the next day's training——)

Huh…… Pandora?
I thought I told you today was a rest day……
You just finished a huge race,
so shouldn't you let your body rest?

Huh…… Pandora?
I thought I told you today was a rest day……
You just finished a huge race,
so shouldn't you let your body rest?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I'm just watching. ……Can't I?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Then let me just stay right here…………

(True to her word,
Pandora stayed planted in that spot the
entire time……just silently staring at
something.)

(What was going through her mind…… I still
didn't know, but——)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
——Phew! That should be plenty for today.
What do you say?
choice_data_list: Right. Let's call it a day
Right. Let's call it a day

text_block_list.name: Single Knot Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Phew~! Great work out there—……!
Whoa~ total scorcher today, huh?

text_block_list.name: Antenna-haired Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Summer's right around the corner,
after all. Ugh,
I'm all sticky…… I wanna dive straight into
the shower right now～

(Pandora…… In the end,
she really did just sit and watch the entire
time, huh? ……Hm?)

(Pandora…… In the end,
she really did just sit and watch the entire
time, huh? ……Hm?)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ……——Senpai.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Hey. ……Can we talk for a sec?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
……Sure,
of course!
Let me just wipe off this sweat first,
though!

(Did……Pandora want to talk to Kraft about
something?
She looked so lost in thought all day…… Is
she going to be alright……?)

(Did……Pandora want to talk to Kraft about
something?
She looked so lost in thought all day…… Is
she going to be alright……?)
——<Ascella>'s Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oops…… Fufuu,
my apologies for startling you like that.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yep! Her former teammates♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
——To be honest,
we're quite surprised.
Pandora-chan……she's really changed,
hasn't she?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
In the most wonderful way possible.
We truly owe Team <Ascella> our thanks,
don't we?

Thanks,
huh…… But I wasn't able to help her reach
the victory she wanted,
so I feel like I only let her down……

Thanks,
huh…… But I wasn't able to help her reach
the victory she wanted,
so I feel like I only let her down……

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
While it is unfortunate,
and I know how deeply frustrating it must
be……even so, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Because,
you remember how Pandora-chan handled it
last time, right?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Right after the 『Oka Sho』.
She outright refused to watch a race she lost,
running away from it entirely.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
For a natural-born genius like her,
accepting defeat must have been unbearable—
—and more than that,
she never saw any reason to bother.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Facing things that felt uncomfortable or
humiliating…… There was never anything that
truly made her burn with the desire to
win.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yet now,
she has completely transformed.
……We've been watching her. Before the 『Oaks』,
during the race itself……and today,
as well.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
In the heart of the Pandora standing before
us now, without a doubt——

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
A kind of restlessness?
Or maybe just this uneasy feeling?
……That's what's been churning inside me this
whole time.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ……Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
It's not 『I'm done』 or 『Forget it,
that was so lame,
whatever』…… It's not like that at all!
That's how I usually felt,
but not this time.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
It feels like……the entire time,
I've just had this one thing echoing in my
head——

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
……Hey,
senpai. ……Ku-chan-senpai.
I ran my heart out in the 『Oaks』.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yeah. ……I watched every single second.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I gave it everything.
But……so many things happened that I just
couldn't make sense of.
I ran until the very end.
All the way……to the finish line,
I really did——

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ……I ran……and yet……!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yeah——

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
It's so frustrating,
isn't it? ……It hurts so much.
Because you really, truly wanted to win,
didn't you, Pandora-san?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
…………It's so frustrating………… I wanted……to win!
……Ugh——!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ghh, Uuuu～～～……! U-Uwaaaaaaaaaah……!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
——It's so frustrating! It's so,
so infuriating!! I wanted to win! I really,
truly wanted to win, damn it!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to win………… I wanted………you to see
me win——!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yeah. ……Yeah. Thank you, Pandora-san.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for carrying those feelings and
running your heart out for me…… Thank
you……

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ugh…… Dammit, dammit…… Dammit, damnit,
damn iiiiiiiit————!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*…… Haa,
this is awful.
My face is gonna be a total disaster tomorrow
after crying like this.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Y-You'll look wonderful! Pandora-san,
you are always adorable! Ummm～…… That's right!
Absolutely lovely and charming!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, we cried a lot,
let out our frustrations... and now.
Now, let's stand up again, together,
Pandora-san.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Together... with senpai?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
——Me too. I lost, and lost,
and it was painful...
And there were times where I thought it was
impossible too.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I was completely worn out.
...Before the Hanshin Uma Musume Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Eh...? But, at that race——!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...I was able to stand again.
Without giving up.
That's why I was able to reach it once
more.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
No, maybe it was the other way around?
"One more time," "one more time"...
"Until we reach it once more,
never give up."
Maybe because Trainer-san and I decided on
that.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Until we reach it, never give up...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Right. That's——our team,
Team <Ascella>'s way!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(...I... see. ...I see.
So that's why... at that time, I——)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Pfft. So it's gonna be revenge~?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Just like that! ...It'll be fine.
We'll still be fine! If we're together!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Yeah, you're right! ...Alll~right~~~...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I won't give up either! I won't give up,
no matter what!
No matter what happens, never ever!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
And then I'll win!
In the fall at the Shuka Sho for sure!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
——That's why, next time!
Just watch me win,
senpai. ...It's a promise!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Fufuu... Yeah. It's a promise!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'll be watching, so show me!
...I'm really looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay, just leave it to me☆
After all, I'm a——

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "Genius♡"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
! Ahahahaha, that's right!
Ku-chan-senpai,
you're the absolute best———♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(...Hey,
senpai. "One more time," "one more time,"
I won't give up. And I'll give it my all~...
I——)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (Want to be like you, Ku-chan-senpai.)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Me too. Just like senpai,
I want to run and——!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...——Senpai?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ku-chan-senpai?
............Are you asleep?
